definitions.explanation: The year after a referenced event or point in time; not necessarily the calendar year following the current one.

examples.japanese: {翌年|よくとし}、{会社|かいしゃ}を{辞|や}めた。
examples.english: The following year, I quit the company.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{入学|にゅうがく}の{翌年|よくとし}に{留学|りゅうがく}した。
examples.english: She studied abroad the year after entering school.

examples.japanese: その{翌年|よくとし}に{結婚|けっこん}した。
examples.english: They got married the year after that.

notes:
COMPOUND: {翌|よく} (next, following) + {年|とし} (year)

ALTERNATE READING: {翌年|よくねん} is also used.

DISTINCTION:
- {翌年|よくとし}/{翌年|よくねん}: the year following a referenced event
- {来年|らいねん}: next year (from the current year)

EXAMPLE: If discussing events in 2020, {翌年|よくとし} would refer to 2021, regardless of the current year.

RELATED:
- {前年|ぜんねん} (the previous year)
